title: The Plate-Piercing Beak Method
summary: Teaches the beak of the warhammer as a piercing tool with four plain blows and two qi-driven punches through plate.

title: Notes on the Crushing Descent
summary: Gathers five plain falling blows and two qi-laden descents that crush a raised shield and the arm behind it.

title: The Ringing Helm Handbook
summary: A handbook of six helm blows and two qi-rung strikes that rattle the skull inside the metal.

title: Collected Methods of the Armored Hammerman
summary: Collects the working methods of the armored foot soldier who carries a hammer into a packed line.

title: A Canon of Hammer and Guard
summary: Sets nine linked methods in which every guard of the haft is paired with a qi-backed answering blow.

title: The Breaker's Second Book
summary: A second book for those who finished the first lessons and now break armor with qi-fed blows.

title: Manual of the Flat Face and the Spike
summary: Shows when to strike with the flat face and when with the spike and joins both in two qi blows.

title: Teachings on Shock Through Steel
summary: Ten teachings on sending the shock of a hammer blow through steel into the body of the wearer.

title: The Haft-Hand Discipline
summary: A discipline of the hands on the haft covering sliding grips short grips and the qi pulse of the wrist.

title: A Field Guide to Armor Breaking
summary: A field guide that tells a hammerman which blow to pick against each kind of armor on a battlefield.
